==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am wearing massive handcuffs that look like they're made of solid yellow slime. They were put on me by a villain during an epic battle. My team's healer made them slightly less heavy after the battle ended.

I am trying to hurry to my class at the superhero academy. I struggle to move very quickly due to the weight of the cuffs. I notice that my fellow students all seem to already be fully healed.

My healer notices me breathless in the classroom. They are shocked to hear that my handcuffs are still weighing me down, as the cuffs should be multiple tons lighter. Finally the healer makes the cuffs vanish and I can breathe a lot easier as a result.
